ins.t: 2026: the best guide to what a defense allows next week was adjusted (opponent-adjusted, recent games count more) — rank correlation +.06, best in 2 of 6 weeks; the weakest was 2024 (+.02). Touchdowns are the noisiest: the best data set for TDs (adjusted) reached only +.04.

2025: the best guide to what a defense allows next week was adjusted (opponent-adjusted, recent games count more) — rank correlation +.05, best in 5 of 17 weeks; the weakest was 2024 (+.04). Touchdowns are the noisiest: the best data set for TDs (adjusted) reached only +.03.
2026, picking touchdowns: His recent PPR ranked scorers best (AUC 0.602; .500 = coin flip), then Anytime-TD model (0.601). TD allowed to his slot: 0.518 · Ψ: 0.521 · META: 0.528 · H2H: 0.489.

2026, the matchup itself (did a player beat his own average?): Implied team total was the best read (ρ +.09); soft third vs tough third by Ψ: +.69 PPR, by TD allowed: +.52, by SCH: +.47, by H2H: +.40.
2025, picking touchdowns: Anytime-TD model ranked scorers best (AUC 0.600; .500 = coin flip), then His recent PPR (0.593). TD allowed to his slot: 0.512 · Ψ: 0.509 · META: 0.537 · H2H: 0.472.
2025, the matchup itself (did a player beat his own average?): SCH was the best read (ρ +.08); soft third vs tough third by Ψ: +.66 PPR, by TD allowed: +.58, by SCH: +1.32, by H2H: −.12.

2026: read through the adjusted table instead of the combined blend (the site's default), the matchup signals got better at calling who beat his own average in 4 of 4 cases — Ψ +.09 vs +.02, TD allowed +.09 vs +.03.
2026: META beat its own parts at picking scorers (AUC 0.528 vs Ψ 0.521, TD allowed 0.518) — most of its edge comes from the anytime-TD model folded inside it (0.601 on its own).
2026: H2H (how he did against this opponent before) carried no signal — AUC 0.489, below a coin flip, and ρ −.03 against his norm; only 50% of players had a prior meeting.

2025: read through the adjusted table instead of the combined blend (the site's default), the matchup signals got better at calling who beat his own average in 4 of 4 cases — Ψ +.05 vs +.04, TD allowed +.04 vs +.04.
